summary: Dragonheir launched an Account Appraisal event allowing new and returning players to receive up to 15,000 Wyrmarrow by submitting gallery screenshots from other strategy RPGs. New players should create their in-game character on a server before submitting appraisal details to ensure rewards link properly. For hero prioritization entering Season 9, Aura and Toxin remain top damage schools, with Talethia and Serpentemis serving as essential carries. Rally and Burn are also strong AoE alternatives, featuring standout performances from Monelisse and Durem without requiring expensive premium units.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: The number one damage dealer to prioritize in Aura teams; acquire as many copies as possible.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: A powerful limited-time Aura core hero arriving on banner who provides strong crowd control and state manipulation.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.note: Outperforms legendary supports for Aura teams by providing buffs, shields, and debuff cleansing.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.note: Key unit to pair alongside Talethia for building a premier Aura core.

heroes.name: Aemonleyda
heroes.note: Not worth pursuing unless pulled accidentally or needed specifically for Magic Chess.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Essential Toxin damage dealer capable of delivering top-tier endgame damage.

heroes.name: Sleight
heroes.note: A primary synergy partner required to make Toxin compositions function at their peak.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Serves as an ideal third damage dealer in standard Toxin lineups.

heroes.name: Sacredeia
heroes.note: Even though she belongs to Corrosion, she inflicts Poison Vulnerability to massively amplify Toxin team damage.

heroes.name: Lothair
heroes.note: Generally unnecessary to build for Toxin teams unless filling Magic Chess requirements.

heroes.name: Monelisse
heroes.note: Significantly stronger in Season 9, scaling very well once you obtain her first duplicate and exclusive artifact.

heroes.name: Gladys
heroes.note: Combines with Monelisse to form an excellent AoE-clearing core.

heroes.name: Durem
heroes.note: Outperforms other options as the primary Burn damage dealer without needing premium investment.

heroes.name: Aschetius
heroes.note: Unnecessary for standard Burn progression unless targeting Magic Chess cores.

heroes.name: Karf
heroes.note: Serves as a better Burn enabler than Vyressa for supporting Durem.

heroes.name: Guinavivre
heroes.note: Offers the highest single-target damage ceiling in Dauntless, but requires Inspiration 5 (6-7 copies) and her exclusive artifact.

heroes.name: Ernesto
heroes.note: Provides incredible survivability alongside respectable cold damage on Ice Blast teams.

heroes.name: Beldelle
heroes.note: A primary damage dealer to run alongside Ernesto in Ice Blast lineups.

meta_changes: Aura compositions gain significant power and new options with the introduction of heroes like Holfast and limited banners like Anneliesis.
Corrosion units like Sacredeia gain increased value in Season 9, synergizing across elements with poison vulnerability.
Monelisse receives high value in Season 9 Rally AoE compositions.
tips: Create your character and log onto a server first before submitting account appraisal screenshots so the appraisal reward properly links to your account.
Account appraisal Wyrmarrow is unlocked progressively as your account hits Resonance levels in increments of 10 up to level 99.
When submitting strategy RPG screenshots for appraisal, use the Hero Gallery screen (showing maximum owned legendaries) rather than the roster screen.
Redeem the active gift code 'dragons9' in lowercase (case-sensitive) for 5 Heliolite Dice and 500 Wyrmarrow.
Bind your email address in the bonus event menu to receive free Heliolite Dice.
